name: VisualUiaVerifyNative.exe
description: A Windows SDK binary for manual and automated testing of Microsoft UI Automation implementation and controls.
author: Jimmy (@bohops)

commands.description: Generate Serialized gadget and save to - `C:\Users\%USERNAME%\AppData\Roaminguiverify.config` before executing.
commands.usecase: Execute proxied payload with Microsoft signed binary to bypass WDAC policies
commands.os: Windows 10 2004 (likely previous and newer versions as well)

detection: As a Windows SDK binary, execution on a system may be suspicious
